Sandbox_AuroraChat_EnableBuffs_desc: Give the players buffs to their stats when in RP.
Sandbox_AuroraChat_AllowPlayerCoords_des: Allow players to see their own coords by using /coords
Sandbox_AuroraChat_EnableModCharacter_de: Allow players to grow hair/beards and set hair color.
Sandbox_AuroraChat_EnableSelfInjury_desc: Allow players to apply injuries to themselves.
Sandbox_AuroraChat_EnableAutoCleanup_des: Allow players to enable auto clean
Sandbox_AuroraChat_EnableBioShortDescrip: Show each character's short description as overhead text above them.
Sandbox_AuroraChat_EnableVoiceChatter_de: Play a short character voice sound when a player speaks in character. Players can still turn it off for themselves.
Sandbox_AuroraChat_RadioStaticFactor_des: Adds a random percentage of extra static to all received radio chatter.
Sandbox_AuroraChat_NameplateRequireLOS_d: Hide overhead names, bios and statuses unless the player's tile is in your view and the game is drawing them (respects HidePlayersBehindYou and sneaking). When off, only the basic wall check is used.
Sandbox_AuroraChat_NameplateDarkLight_de: At or below this tile light level, overhead names are fully hidden.
Sandbox_AuroraChat_NameplateFullLight_de: At or above this tile light level, overhead names are fully visible. Between the two values they fade.
